description: This file handles updating relationships between entities in the vtiger CRM system, specifically related to campaign module relations. It processes input parameters, manages entity relation data, and redirects to appropriate views.

classes.name: CRMEntity
classes.description: Represents a CRM entity with methods for handling entity data, notably the getInstance method for instantiation.

methods.name: vtlib_purify
methods.description: Sanitizes input data to prevent security vulnerabilities like SQL injection.

methods.name: getParentTab
methods.description: Retrieves the parent tab context for the current module view.

methods.name: CRMEntity::getInstance
methods.description: Creates or retrieves an instance of CRMEntity for a given module.

methods.name: relateEntities
methods.description: Establishes relationships between CRM entities based on provided IDs and modules.
